Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) — it applies to every AI coding assistant working in
this repository. In short: settings belong in `app/config.gs`; never add real
students' data; and **a change is only ready to deploy when `npm run verify` ends with
"✅ VERIFIED — safe to deploy"**. For helping someone set up TermSync, follow
[SETUP_WITH_AI.md](../SETUP_WITH_AI.md).
